headline: Nvidia in Talks to Offer Credit Support for Nscale Project
author: Brody Ford

paragraphs.text: Thu, October 29, 2026 at 5:59 PM MDT 2 min read
(Bloomberg) -- Nvidia Corp. is in discussions to provide credit guarantees for an Nscale data center facility that Anthropic PBC plans to use, according to a person familiar with the matter.

The credit support would help backstop the electricity and construction costs for an AI data center campus in West Virginia that will be equipped with Nvidia chips, said the person, who asked not to be identified because the discussions are private. Nvidia, the dominant provider of artificial intelligence processors, is already an investor in Nscale and other providers of AI computing services.

UK-based Nscale is racing to get a series of large data centers online, including this flagship site in West Virginia. It is also pursuing an initial public offering, with some investors pushing back on its $30 billion IPO target.

A representative for Nscale declined to comment, while Nvidia didn't immediately respond to a request for comment. The Information previously reported on Nvidia's discussions with Nscale, saying that the credit guarantees could amount to billions of dollars.
Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said earlier this month that he told the UK—based company to "work around the clock" to overcome challenges in bringing some of its data centers online.

The broader market for so-called neoclouds — companies like Nscale that provide AI computing power — has been in turmoil during recent weeks. Australian company Firmus Grid, another Nvidia-backed neocloud, abandoned a $30 billion IPO in Australia and South Korea's Elice had a rocky trading debut.
Bloomberg News has reported that Nscale has discussed a second $45 billion deal with Anthropic for the second building on the West Virginia campus.
